title: Locusts
overview: A locust plague is looming, and mysteriously, a book on insects belonging to the Shi clan appears.

title: The Fire-Rat Cloak
overview: An interesting cloak points Maomao's imagination towards international politics.

title: Let Them Eat Cake
overview: Maomao treats a sick girl, but food poisoning and malnutrition are not the true problems that need solving.

title: The Last Volume
overview: Trying to track down the missing final book, Maomao visits Suirei, who is now living with Ah-Duo.

title: The White-Snake Immortal
overview: Maomao's stepbrother Lahan takes her to a popular show that may be more than just entertainment.

title: The Paper Village
overview: Maomao needs to find someone to cover for her while she goes on a trip with Jinshi. A good candidate turns up.

title: The Bet
overview: As paper makers and farmers hold discussions, Maomao and Jinshi notice something unusual.
